description: val4-fvs-05: val3-fvs-08 again, with one change: Probe!A1 is `=2^1023` instead of a label. Excel runs B1, its observers B2:B5 (moved to just after B1), then A1. If an overflowing FVSCHEDULE leaves a state that the next literal `^` takes, A1 is #NUM!, the workbook ends with nothing pending and the canary's SQRT(2) is 1.4142135623730951, so the fill is not refused and B1 = FVSCHEDULE(2^1023,{1,-0.5}) is read at last: 0, TYPE 1, ISNUMBER TRUE, code 0, B5 0. One workbook per case, filled like val3 (rustsheet-oracle fill -b excel-graph, each case its own session). Raw values only. Precision!B2:B4 must be 0.9999999999999998, 1, 1.0000000000000002 and C2:C4 -1, 0, 1. Predictions are hypotheses, NOT expected values. If the canary refuses a workbook, keep the downloaded bytes and report `rustsheet-eval snapshot` of them: the refusal is a result. Protocol and frozen predictions: docs/research/r8fvs-carried-overflow-state-2026-11-10.md.
